item.title: Environment Department blocks Larnaca breakwater plan over irreversible damage fears
item.description: A negative opinion from Cyprus’s Department of Environment has frozen plans to construct breakwaters and perpendicular groins along the coastal front from Kiti Cape to Larnaca airport area. item.title: Driver suffers leg amputations in serious motorway crash near Limassol
item.description: A 30-year-old Greek Cypriot driver suffered leg amputations and remains in very serious condition after his car veered off the Limassol-Paphos motorway and crashed into a metal barrier at midnight yesterday. item.title: Man faces 15 child pornography charges involving own daughter
item.description: A 45-year-old man is set to answer 15 charges in early March over possession and production of child pornography, with some material involving his own underage daughter. Limassol Criminal Court adjourned proceedings on Wednesday, with the defendant remaining free under restrictive conditions. The man faces charges of possession, acquisition, production and distribution of child pornography. […]

item.description: Cyprus’s most important wetland faces ecological disaster as flamingo numbers crashed from 13,000 in previous years to just 47 this month, the Parliamentary Environment Committee heard on Wednesday.
